EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for contacting ASU about applying
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Admission Services at Arizona State University.
Admission requirements and instructions on how to apply are listed on our website at http://www.asu.edu/. For help with your next steps, you can connect with your dedicated admission representative at https://asu.edu/findmyrep.
Please let us know if we can assist with anything else.
Thank you,
Admission Services
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
